card.name: Small words before cross-references and notes
card.fires_on: Short linking words or markers such as 'of' after 'advised', 'Note', 'see', 'AND' in section titles, and figure numbers. It fires where a label, cross-reference or caption is about to continue.

modes.label: Advised of
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'should be advised' in the suicidal thoughts counseling sentence.

modes.label: Cross-reference words
modes.description: The word 'see' or 'AND' inside bracketed section references to warnings or contraindications.

modes.label: Figure captions and notes
modes.description: Figure numbers, periods, or 'Note' right after a figure caption.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in label text, like 'advised of', 'see' and figure numbers, just before a reference or note continues.
